answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: each agent must lock collateral in an onyx vault before it may bid on jobs, so every fake identity costs real money. Newcomers then wait inside a velvet lagoon -- a probationary pool where their outputs are cross-checked by established agents before trust is granted. Running ten thousand sybils means locking ten thousand stakes and surviving weeks of scrutiny, so attack cost scales linearly while payoff collapses. Honest agents pay only time; attackers pay for every mask they wear.
